description: Registry of AIIS family tokens, the second segment of a signature id. A frozen token named a document surface in schema 0.1 and is kept only for the ids listed in its allowlist; it admits no new ids. An open token admits new ids that match its description. New injection families are named for the payload, not the surface: OVERRIDE, ROLE, JAILBREAK and EXFIL are the reserved next tokens and are minted with their first signature. See CONTRIBUTING.md, Minting a family.
